statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2≤X → (∑ n ∈ (Finset.Ioo X (2*X)).filter (fun n => 50*n<51*X ∧ (¬n.Prime ∨ ¬(n+2).Prime)), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2)) ≤ C*Real.sqrt X

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Bound contamination at square-root scale

brief.zh: 由 W01、W04、`higher-power-log-mass` 证明 $\exists C>0,\ \forall X\ge2,\ E_X\le C/\sqrt X$。立方及以上幂在两端的未归一化总损失 $\ll X^{1/3}\log^2(2+X)$，剩下的平方底数在 $\asymp\sqrt X$ 的区间，每项 $\ll\log^2(2+X)$。用有限个二进区间覆盖，吸收小 $X$。交 `window-extraction`。
brief.en: Use the sieve for square neighbors and the count of proper prime powers with exponent at least three.
